question: Oliver Kell's price-cycle framework favors buying strength near highs, not chasing deep extended moves off lows; on four_pct days, expect being CLOSE to the 52-week high (small pct_52wh) to do BETTER than being far below it (large pct_52wh).
plain: Oliver Kell's price-cycle idea says the best buys are stocks near their 52-week high, not ones far below it; this checks if 4%-up days near the high do better than 4%-up days far from the high.
